card.name: Just before 'ur' in urinary words
card.fires_on: The piece of a word right before an 'ur' or 'U' continues it, as in trans|urethral, olig|uria, vesico-|ureteral, genit|ourinary. Also the open bracket before BUN in the osmolality formula.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with 'ur' or 'U' to spell out urinary words like urethral, uria and ureteral.
card.plain: It fires on the opening part of a urinary word when the next letters are likely 'ur', as in transurethral or oliguria.
